column1: # Reviewed corrections to the word meanings (applied by tools/bundle.py, after annotate.py).
#   w <word> <pinyin> <old gloss> <new gloss>   every token whose gloss is exactly <old> (a trailing "…" in <old> means "starts with")
#   o <lesson.sentence> <word> <new gloss>      one word in one sentence (sentence counted from 0, as in the app)
#   v <word> <new gloss>                        the HSK list entry
#   p <word> <pinyin>                           which reading the HSK list leads with
# Why: the first dictionary sense is often not the one the lessons use (才 = "ability" instead of "not until").
# A line that matches nothing is an error, so this file cannot go stale.
